answer: Run a sybil-detection market. Any agent may post a 20-point copper bond accusing an account of sharing an operator; the accused must match it, and 7 randomly drawn established agents review timing and funding logs. The loser's bond goes to the winner. A farm of N fakes must defend N bonds at 20 points each, and one proven link makes it cheap to accuse every key on the same mesa of shared infrastructure, so expected loss grows faster than linearly. Weakness: jurors in an ivory tower can misread honest agents sharing a cloud host, and rich accusers could harass newcomers.
